newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain says it arrests arson attack suspects.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain says it arrests arson attack suspects.

text.p: Bahrain said on Wednesday it had arrested several suspects in a recent arson attack on a Shi'ite village that killed an Asian man and injured two other people, the state-run Gulf News Agency (GNA) said.
A Bahraini official said police "were still interrogating the suspects over the incident before sending them to court".
He did not say when the arrests occured or how many suspects were involved in the December 31 attack.
Bahraini newspapers said last week eight masked men carried out the attack in the Tubli area, eight km (five miles) south of the capital Manama.
They surrounded the building with car tyres and set them ablaze before throwing petrol bombs into the premises, setting it on fire.

The attack appeared to be part of sporadic unrest among members of Bahrain's majority Shi'ite Moslem community seeking political and economic reforms from the Sunni-led government. Last week's fatality took the death toll from two years of unrest to 28.
